value: Under @tsl1 a card whose effect lands inside the turn (damage, HP kept, cards played) or whose turn-start tick needs no chance has no zero-shot cost one turn deep (19/22 Act 1 pack cards level); cards whose value is a number left in the leaf state (Disarm, Impervious, Intimidate: -0.06..-0.12 wins) are not covered.
